lines.en: My big foot snaps a pine branch.

lines.zh: 原始松林里，我走得比风轻
lines.en: In old growth pines, I'm lighter than wind.
Pine needles cling to my fur.

lines.zh: 我穿过林子，只留下味道
lines.en: I pass through leaving only scent.
One stride is two of yours.
I follow the railway line.
The hunting tower's shadow lies beneath me.

lines.zh: 我绕着你走，一圈比一圈近
lines.en: I circle you, closer every lap.
This fur is the pine forest's gift.
I don't care for daylight.

lines.zh: 铁路废弃很久了，我记得
lines.en: The railway's been abandoned long; I remember.

lines.zh: 我走过去，草丛才慢慢合上
lines.en: The grass closes slowly after me.
When I stand, the forest goes quiet.
The detector ticks on you.
These pines are mine.
I smell a campfire.
Hunters came; they didn't go back.
Counting how many came with you.
My anger is slowly rising.
Stay longer and it gets worse.

lines.zh: 这棵树上留着我的抓痕
lines.en: My claw marks are on this tree.
I need no den; the forest is one.
At night I can see you.
I've followed you a long while.

lines.zh: 别抬头，上面什么都没有
lines.en: Don't look up; nothing's there.
You brought the detector.
It ticks, so I'm close.
You can't see me clearly; that's right.
You stand on my ground.
I'm watching the lamp in your hand.

lines.zh: 那双红眼睛，你看到了吗
lines.en: Did you see those red eyes?
Get far from your base.
You smell of camp smoke.
Look back and I vanish.
You shouldn't have come alone.

lines.zh: 我的愤怒已经写在脸上
lines.en: My anger shows on my face.
You still have a chance to leave.
I've torn planks off the hunting tower.
That gun is light before me.

lines.zh: 我能一口气跑到你的营地
lines.en: I can reach your camp in one run.
Hear the forest stirring?
That's not the wind.
I stepped back, angrier.
Pain only makes me fiercer.
Fur took most of it.
Did you hear my roar?
That's no wound.
I wiped my mouth.

lines.zh: 你这一下，让我记住你的味道
lines.en: That taught me your scent.
The whole forest echoes.

lines.zh: 你已经没有第二次机会
lines.en: You won't get a second chance.
I won't eat what's in your hand.
Set it down; I'm not hungry.
Testing me with food?
That doesn't suit my appetite.
The friendlier you act, the warier I get.

lines.zh: 我吃的是林子里的东西
lines.en: I eat what the forest gives.
Raise your hands so I see them.
Don't trade that for your life.

lines.zh: 我愤怒的时候不吃东西
lines.en: I don't eat when angry.
Put it away; my patience is short.

lines.zh: 你的肩膀撞上我的胸口
lines.en: Your shoulder hit my chest.
I'm a wall of tree before you.
You stumbled back a few paces.
This fur is thick; it doesn't hurt.
You stepped in my footprint.
One hand could sweep you aside.
Don't touch my arm.

lines.zh: 撞我，是激怒我的一种方式
lines.en: Bumping me is one way to anger me.
You're already too close.
I'm alone in these pines.
That's not what I wait for.

lines.zh: 你连我长什么样都没看清
lines.en: You haven't even seen my face.

lines.zh: 愤怒涨起来，别的都没了
lines.en: When anger rises, nothing else remains.
I carry pine sap and soil.

lines.zh: 满身松脂味，你还敢靠这么近。
lines.en: You smell of pine resin, and still you come this close.
Wrong time for that question.
The forest will answer for me.
Leave.

lines.zh: 地上有猎人留下的东西
lines.en: Something hunters left behind.
I pick up a scrap of cloth.
It smells of the living.

lines.zh: 骨头不算什么，我见多了
lines.en: Bones are nothing; I've seen many.
I put it in a tree hollow.
Supplies from the tower are mine.
The railway often has dropped things.
I pick it up and toss it away.
This wood has claw marks.
My anger has peaked.
From now on, this is a hunting ground.
Hear the tree falling?
I'll cut off your retreat first.
The tower won't stop me.
Your lamp doesn't reach far.
One stride of mine is three of yours.
This time I won't hide.
There's sound behind you too.

lines.zh: 我把愤怒都记在你身上
lines.en: I'll put all my anger on you.
Don't think of running to camp.
Your companions can't find this place.
Red eyes mean it's time.
My hand is up.
The forest has cleared the way.
Each step of yours brings me a foot closer.
Branches break behind me.
Your lamp is shaking.
In the old pine wood, my anger rises again.
Look back and you'll only see trees.
The tower isn't safe.
I watched you climb it.
I wait below.
The railway leads nowhere.
You haven't noticed the extra prints.
Those aren't yours.
I needn't run; I'm fast enough.
You've veered off course.
These pines have no exit.
It's getting dark.
One swipe and you're airborne.
My hand is bigger than your head.
You're pinned to a trunk.
Under the fur is all muscle.
I've torn sheet iron.
This one makes ribs sound.
You stepped back twice, unsteady.
My claws aren't long; they're enough.
I drag you into the trees.
Whatever you held fell.
This blow comes from above.
You blocked, and your arm broke.
Two swipes.

lines.zh: 我撕开过铁皮，你的护甲也一样。
lines.en: I have torn tin open; your armor is no different.
I leave no one.

lines.zh: 这片松林会收拾剩下的
lines.en: The pines will handle the rest.

lines.zh: 松林深处有东西站了起来
lines.en: Something stands deep in the pines.
The detector ticks for the first time.
I snap a branch.
You've only just entered this forest.
My fur stands on end.
There's an earthy smell in the woods.
The tower's ladder creaks once.
Footsteps come from the railway.
I chose you.
I've noted your camp.
It's nearly dark; good.
That red point isn't a firefly.
Did you hear that?
I treat this forest as mine.
Easy to enter, hard to leave.
Fire caught my fur; I beat it out.

lines.zh: 从树上摔下来，腿有点麻
lines.en: I fell from a tree; my legs are numb.
Water feels strange.
The blast tore up the pine branches.
Something pierced my shoulder.
I don't know this smell.
Nothing to eat here; I'm hungry.
Lightning hit the pine and me.
No ground; I can't grab a tree.
